idee_recherchee.texte: Physicists suggest that spacetime is not a fundamental part of reality but an emergent property that arises from deeper quantum information, so the smooth four-dimensional fabric we experience would only be an approximation.

titre_video: Scientists Are Freaking Out Over Space Time (It's Not Real)
titre: Résultat : la mécanique quantique gagne encore
resume: The entangled photons still behaved as if connected through space and time, even when the choices came from light that left its source billions of years ago. Quantum mechanics won again and the result was not close.
texte: That's not what happened. When the scientists analyzed their findings, their conclusions were unequivocal. Just like in so many other Bell tests, the entangled photons behaved like they were connected through space and time. Even when the choices were dictated by light that left its source billions of years ago, nothing changed. Quantum mechanics won again, and it wasn't even close.
